name: parquet-d
description: Native D Parquet writer and reader for flat schemas. Writer: single row group, PLAIN values, RLE/bit-packed definition levels for real nulls, zstd or uncompressed pages. Reader: externally produced files (pyarrow/HF corpora) with PLAIN/dictionary/RLE encodings, v1/v2 data pages, and SNAPPY (native decoder), ZSTD, GZIP, or uncompressed pages. Footer metadata goes through a vendored copy of Apache Thrift's own D TCompactProtocol (six files, no libevent/openssl).
preBuildCommands: $DC -lib -O -oq -Ithird_party -od=.dub/thrift/obj -of=.dub/thrift/libthrift_compact.a third_party/thrift/base.d third_party/thrift/internal/endian.d third_party/thrift/protocol/base.d third_party/thrift/protocol/compact.d third_party/thrift/transport/base.d third_party/thrift/transport/memory.d
